quote: It should be remembered that in May 2025 the Corporation selected Rio Tinto as a strategic partner for the lithium project in Maricunga, committing a capital contribution of up to US$900 million to develop this initiative… The modification of this CEOL is one of those conditions; others remain, such as obtaining free competition approvals in some foreign countries, which is projected to be achieved during 2026.
note: Opened Codelco English primary 2026-10-04; CEOL amendment / Rio USD 900m commitment / JV conditions precedent confirmed; CapEx not disbursed.
